findings.invariant: A successful v3 verification must reject every locally malformed ADR-0125 field and nested object in the seven supplied envelopes; a finite private table must specify the exact scalar/tag/array grammar it claims to enforce.
findings.worked_counterexample: Supply canonical, correctly signed ScopeIntent bytes whose ActionIntent has an extra key in predecessor_output_refs[*], a malformed required_input_contracts[*] or output_contract, a reordered root_published_input_ids/predecessor_output_refs/required_input_contracts array, or an invalid ActionIntent/ReplayIntent self-digest. The v3 table lists ActionIntent and ReplayIntent only at their outer key level; it gives no exact shapes, sort keys, uniqueness/cardinality, fixed action/replay IDs, phase enum, or self-digest rule for those children. Likewise it names CES/PEA/CAS/PCE maps but does not state scalar/tag values for subject_ref.kind, authority_ref.kind, phase, receipt-schema selector, IDs, or positions. P3V3-02 promises every embedded wrong key/scalar/array refuses, but a conforming implementation has no code-pinned value grammar with which to make those refusals and must either accept a malformed signed envelope or invent policy.
findings.consequence: The advertised exact local-schema verifier can return a verified value for bytes ADR-0125 requires to refuse. Although v3 deliberately has no effect route, that is a materially incorrect verification result and defeats the fixed default-deny boundary needed before any later consumer can rely on it.
findings.required_disposition: Do not authorize RED. Add finite private-table rows for every nested ActionIntent, ReplayIntent, predecessor-output, input-contract, output-contract, CES/PCE/CAS and PublishedInputEntry child; state scalar grammars, literal tags/enums, exact array sort/unique/cardinality rules, and every embedded self-digest/preimage validated locally. List any deliberately unvalidated field as unresolved without describing its schema as exact. Repeat Phase 0.

findings.invariant: All ADR-0125 links directly comparable among the six supplied envelopes must be compared, including PEA phase/authority-tag/subject compatibility and the selected action-or-replay admission's compatibility with the common subject; unresolved external targets cannot erase these same-request equalities.
findings.location_entry_point: 0041 direct_link_table, embedded_shape_rules, unresolved_refs, and P3V3-05; proposed HistoricalStudyEnvelopeVerifier.verify.
findings.worked_counterexample: For bootstrap, provide ScopeIntent S1 and a canonical signed action CES/PEA/BVP/CAS chain whose PEA authority_ref is {kind:scope-intent-gate-set,scope_intent_sha256:S2,gate_set_sha256:G}; S2 is syntactically valid but differs from S1. The table labels that PEA field unresolved and never compares it to S1's supplied self-digest, despite ADR-0125 requiring the tag to equal its phase Scope fact. Separately, give every CES/PEA/BVP/CAS an action subject {action_id:A,action_intent_sha256:IA} but select a signed ActionExecutionAdmission for B/IB that repeats the same supplied CAS/PEA/CES/BVP digest strings; or use a replay subject with a FinalReplayAdmission for another replay. All listed v3 pair rows pass: they never compare admission action_id/action_intent_sha256 or replay_id/replay_intent_sha256 to the common subject, nor require action admission only for action phases and final replay admission only for replay-pre-final. The table also does not define the required phase-to-authority_ref-kind map or compare scope-action/replay authority_ref intent digest to the same subject tag.
findings.consequence: A signed but foreign Scope tag or a mismatched action/replay admission can be returned as one non-authorizing verified envelope set. It breaks ADR-0125's required phase/subject/authority binding at the direct boundary and gives a later effect packet an ambiguously assembled chain.
findings.required_disposition: Do not authorize RED. Extend direct_link_table with bootstrap PEA authority_ref.scope_intent_sha256 == supplied ScopeIntent digest; phase-to-subject and phase-to-authority_ref-kind mapping; scope-action/replay authority-ref intent == subject intent; and selected admission kind/ID/intent == the shared subject. Record every comparison that remains impossible only because its target is absent, and remove any table equality not actually required by ADR-0125. Repeat Phase 0.

findings.invariant: The direct-link table must not impose an ADR-0125 equality that rejects a valid phase; ScopeIntent's root PIS is not the later stage or replay PIS carried by scope-action/replay-pre-final CES and PEA.
findings.location_entry_point: 0041 direct_link_table rows scope_intent--ces and scope_intent--pea; P3V3-05.
findings.worked_counterexample: Supply a valid scope-action chain. ScopeIntent is necessarily bound to the root PIS (its basis names the root PIS), while a stage PIS is separately signed from Scope plus predecessor StageAdmissions/publication receipts. CES and PEA for that action carry the stage PIS. The same conflict occurs for replay-pre-final CES/PEA, whose PIS is the replay PIS made from already PUBLISHED tape/release/profile outputs and never depends on Final Manifest. v3 unconditionally requires scope_intent.published_input_set_sha256 == ces.published_input_set_sha256 and == pea.published_input_set_sha256, so it refuses both ADR-valid non-bootstrap profiles.
findings.consequence: The advertised action-or-final-replay verifier is materially incompatible with every valid later action and pre-final replay chain; an implementer can only pass its positive path by treating a wrong root PIS as the stage/replay PIS or by rejecting the legitimate profile.
findings.required_disposition: Do not authorize RED. Make the ScopeIntent-to-CES/PEA PIS equality conditional on bootstrap only. For scope-action and replay-pre-final, treat the stage/replay PIS target as unresolved in this narrowed packet, or add only an ADR-authorized supplied direct relation. Sweep every other unconditional scope-to-later-phase equality and record its ADR basis before repeating Phase 0.
